body: I notice their eyes are closed tightly, shivering slightly against the cold night air. Their hands clutch desperately at the dashboard, as if searching for safety in familiar places. My instinctual urge to shield them becomes stronger. I take a deep breath, inhaling the scent of diesel fumes and the distant sound of sirens, feeling an inner calm despite the tension.
